notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 is out
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved overall performance
[*] Fixed bug that ignored some chapters when unlocking gates
[*] Fixed issue with default resolution being very low, when starting the game the first time
[*] Fixed issue with windowed-mode, where the two modes were switched around
[*] Fixed issue with multiple achievements not unlocking (If you’ve completed the game and are missing achievements please try launching the game after this update)
[*] Fixed issue with reset save where unlockable gates were still down
[/list]

notes.title: Strange shape-shifting puzzler Altered releases on March 12
notes.content:
Altered from developer Glitchheart is an upcoming meditative puzzle game mixing hard puzzles and a soothing atmosphere, as you move and morph yourself around small areas to complete each puzzle.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/02/strange-shape-shifting-puzzler-altered-releases-on-march-12

notes.title: Altered is coming out March 12th! New trailer and demo
notes.content:
Altered is coming out on March 12th! Watch the new trailer right here, and try the updated demo.

[previewyoutube=ku41ODsT--I;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Dive into a meditative atmosphere, where puzzles can be solved at your own pace
notes.content:
Altered is a meditative puzzle game about overcoming old memories through challenging puzzles.
Sit back, take a deep breath and solve difficult puzzles at your own pace in this calm place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34915015/a25fbb03027712fb220ab1869a5fad136c481b8f.gif[/img]

To celebrate the Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition we are sharing our first official demo and can't wait to hear what people think.

notes.title: Altered now has a free demo!
notes.content:
As part of the Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition that starts tomorrow we thought we would share a demo of Altered for everyone to try out.
The demo is available on Windows, MacOS and Linux right now!

Give it a try and let us know what you think. We'd love your feedback.

notes.title: New gameplay trailer!
notes.content:
We've been working hard on Altered over the past year, and we're getting closer to release every day. Most recently we've been working on updating our style and characters and now we've made this [b]gameplay trailer[/b] to showcase how the game looks in this new style!

We hope you like the new look and we are very excited to show you more of the game once we get closer to release.

[b]Keep checking the store page for more updates and info[/b]
